correctness.rationale: For n=p-1 with odd prime p, the path sin-eigenmodes yield rational independence of cos(pi j/p) for 1<=j<=(p-1)/2 using primitive cyclotomic minimal polynomial, so energy sums only collide by exchange or total zero. A rank-one corner absorber removes exactly the bright one-dimensional direction per energy and all remaining bright modes decay for any J,kappa>0. Thus P_bright=P_symmetric-P_zero,symmetric+P_zero,rankone. Fourier completeness gives diagonal symmetric zero-energy weight (1+[x=y]/2)/p on equal coordinate parity, zero otherwise, while the normalized bright-zero vector is proportional to (4I-A^2) at diagonal and separation two. Substitution yields the five exclusive cases and multiplicities. Independent exact-degeneracy-mode numerical computation at p=3,5,7,11,13,17 covers every site with maximum error 2.67e-15, including average 1/2+1/(p-1)^2. Finite tests do not prove arbitrary primes.
